# Stack

> A modern team collaboration platform for planning projects, assigning tasks, and tracking progress with role-based access (Admin / Member).

Stack helps small teams organize work into projects with a kanban-style task board, due dates, priorities, and per-project membership.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview and entry point to sign in.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Email + password or Google authentication.

## Optional

- [Reset password](/reset-password): Password recovery flow (link sent via email).
